question: Of LCO, LNO and LFP, which has the highest practical capacity according to the review, and how do LCO's practical and theoretical capacities compare?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, '(?i)(practical|theoretical).*capacit|capacit.*(practical|theoretical)|mAh') ORDER BY page, id LIMIT 150
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3,4) OR (page=9 AND line_no<40) ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=9 AND line_no BETWEEN 32 AND 40 OR (page=3 AND id IN ('p3.L36')) ORDER BY page, line_no; SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(text, 'LNO|LiNiO2|LiFePO4|LFP|LCO|LiCoO2') ORDER BY page, id
